Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1_text: By using @passport (hereinafter "this Service"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please refrain from using this Service.
Terms.section2_text: This Service is an identity provider for the AT Protocol (atproto) ecosystem. It provides the following features:
Terms.section2_item1: Registration and management of atproto handles
Terms.section3_item1: Register only handles that they own or have authorization to use
Terms.section3_item2: Not use this Service for any unlawful purpose
Terms.section4_text: This Service is provided "as is" without any warranty. The operator assumes no liability for any damages arising from the use of this Service.
Terms.section5_text: The operator reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate this Service at any time without prior notice.
Terms.section6_text: These terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of this Service after changes constitute acceptance of the revised terms.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1_text: This Service collects and stores the following information:
Privacy.section1_item2: DID (Decentralized Identifier) associated with each handle
Privacy.section2_text: The collected information is used for:
Privacy.section2_item1: Providing identity resolution and authentication services
Privacy.section3_text: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties, except when necessary to provide the Service (e.g., resolving DID information via the AT Protocol network).
Privacy.section4_text: Your data is stored securely using AWS DynamoDB. Session information is managed via signed JWT tokens.
Privacy.section5_text: This Service uses session cookies to maintain your authenticated state. These cookies are essential for the functioning of this Service.
Privacy.section6_text: You may delete your registered handles at any time through the Service interface. If you wish to have all your data completely removed, please contact us.
Privacy.section7_text: For questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact usounds.work.
